name: Restless Soul
body:
Restless souls are spirits of the deceased who, bound by unfulfilled vows, tragic deaths, or intense personal purpose, have returned from the ethereal border to interact with the world of the living. While standard ghosts are incorporeal terrors, restless souls have condensed their spiritual essence into a semi-tangible ectoplasmic form that allows them to take up weapons and adventure beside the living.

Standard Racial Traits
Ability Score Racial Traits: Restless souls are driven by immense force of will and personal magnetism, but their ectoplasmic tether is fragile. They gain +2 Wisdom, +2 Charisma, and -2 Constitution.
Type: Undead (augmented humanoid). Restless souls are undead creatures. Unlike standard undead monsters, restless soul player characters retain a Constitution score to represent their tether to life and are healed by both positive and negative energy (healing half the normal amount from each).
Size: Medium. Restless souls have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.
Speed: Normal. Restless souls have a base land speed of 30 feet, and can hover up to 1 foot above the ground or liquid surfaces without penalty.
Languages: Restless souls begin play speaking Common. Bonus languages include Celestial, Draconic, Infernal, and Undercommon.
Senses and Defense Racial Traits
Darkvision: Restless souls can see in the dark up to 60 feet.
Semi-Corporeal (Su): A restless soul can wield physical weapons, wear physical armor, and manipulate physical objects normally. Against non-magical physical attacks, a restless soul gains a +1 deflection bonus to AC.
Spirit Resilience: Restless souls gain complete immunity to non-magical disease, exhaustion, fatigue, and magical sleep effects. They gain a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against death effects, paralysis, poison, and stunning.
Magical and Skill Racial Traits
Ghostly Step (Su): Once per day as a swift action, a restless soul can become completely incorporeal for 1 round. While incorporeal, the restless soul gains a fly speed of 30 feet (perfect), ignores physical armor bonuses, and takes half damage from corporeal magic sources (and no damage from non-magical weapons).
Deathly Presence: Restless souls gain a +2 racial bonus on Intimidate and Stealth checks.
